HEADER.TITLE: Arroyo
HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Configure the Arroyo features for this account. Every feature starts disabled.

GENERAL.TITLE: General
GENERAL.DESCRIPTION: Business settings shared by every feature.

TIMEZONE.LABEL: Time zone
TIMEZONE.HELP: IANA identifier, for example America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires. Used for send hours and to group the panel by day.

WINDOW_KEEPER.TITLE: 24-hour window
WINDOW_KEEPER.DESCRIPTION: Before a WhatsApp conversation's 24-hour window closes, send a single message with buttons inviting the customer to reply. Only the customer's reply reopens the window.

NUDGE_AFTER_HOURS.LABEL: Send after (hours)
NUDGE_AFTER_HOURS.HELP: Hours since the customer's last message. The message is sent before 23 h 45 min.

NUDGE_TEXT.LABEL: Message
NUDGE_TEXT.HELP: You can use variables such as {variable}.

NUDGE_BUTTONS.LABEL: Buttons
NUDGE_BUTTONS.HELP: Up to 3 buttons of up to 20 characters. Press Enter to add each one.

SKIP_LABELS.LABEL: Skip conversations with these labels
SKIP_LABELS.HELP: Press Enter to add each label.

REENGAGEMENT_TEMPLATE.LABEL: Re-engagement template
REENGAGEMENT_TEMPLATE.HELP: Optional. Approved WhatsApp template sent when the window closes without a reply. Leave empty to disable it (templates are paid).

POST_SALE.TITLE: Post-sale
POST_SALE.DESCRIPTION: Chatwoot records the purchase when the sale label is applied. n8n reads this configuration, schedules and sends follow-ups; Chatwoot checks delivery and creates manual tasks. Alerts use native mentions and each manager's notification preferences.

TRIGGER_LABEL.LABEL: Sale label
TRIGGER_LABEL.HELP: Applying this label records the purchase date and seller. n8n schedules the stages from that date.

SEND_HOUR_LOCAL.LABEL: Send hour
SEND_HOUR_LOCAL.HELP: Hour of the day (0 to 23) used by n8n in the business time zone. Defaults to 10:00 every day.

TEMPLATE.LABEL: Meta template
TEMPLATE.HELP: This approved template is always used. Edit its message in Meta.

DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_HOURS.LABEL: Delivery timeout (hours)
DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_HOURS.HELP: Chatwoot creates a task if delivery is not confirmed after an attempt, or if n8n does not schedule or execute on time. Defaults to 6 hours.

ALERT_USERS.LABEL: Alert managers
ALERT_USERS.HELP: They are mentioned in a private note when manual contact is needed. Configure managers with inbox access before enabling.

AGENT_PANEL.TITLE: Agent panel

AGENTS_SEE_ONLY_OWN.LABEL: Agents only see their own activity

HIDE_NATIVE_REPORTS.LABEL: Hide native reports from the sidebar

AGENT_PANEL.COMMERCIAL_HELP: The deadline counts Monday–Saturday, 08:30–12:00 and 16:30–20:30. Assignment includes automatic assignments, manual claims and transfers within the configured lookback.

EMAIL_MARKETING.TITLE: Email marketing
EMAIL_MARKETING.DESCRIPTION: Email campaigns sent through an email inbox with its own SMTP.

FOOTER_HTML.LABEL: Footer (HTML)
FOOTER_HTML.HELP: Company name and address shown at the bottom of every campaign email. The unsubscribe link is added automatically.

FOLLOW_UP.TITLE: Automatic commercial follow-up
FOLLOW_UP.DESCRIPTION: Automatic follow-ups sent from Chatwoot. They go out every day at 10:00 (Argentina time) using the seg_dia_1, seg_dia_3 and seg_dia_5 templates, and replace the n8n flow. Requires the commercial funnel to be on.

ALIASES.LABEL: Advisor aliases
ALIASES.HELP: The name each advisor signs with in the template. For example, Julieta Peralta signs as Juli.
ALIASES.EMPTY: There are no aliases yet. Without an alias, the template is signed with the agent's full name.
ALIASES.NAME: Agent name in Chatwoot
ALIASES.INVALID: Fill in the name and alias of every row or remove the extra ones.

PANEL.TITLE: Agent panel
PANEL.DESCRIPTION: Daily activity per agent. Click any number to see the conversations behind it.

POST_SALE.DESCRIPTION: n8n schedules and sends follow-ups. Check their delivery here and record manual contact when needed.
POST_SALE.NEW_OPPORTUNITY_CANCELLATION: Stage interrupted after confirming a new purchase intent. The previous sale and its messages are preserved.
POST_SALE.DISABLED_HISTORY: The integration is disabled; history remains available and you can resolve pending manual tasks.
POST_SALE.DATE_HELP: Time in {timezone}. A correction only changes stages with no attempt yet; n8n schedules them again.
POST_SALE.NO_MESSAGE: No message has been created for this stage yet.
POST_SALE.RESOLVE_HELP: Record contact you have already made. This does not send messages or change automatic delivery status.
POST_SALE.COUNTS_HELP: Numbers count stages matching the filters. Manual contact is independent of delivery status. Canceled stages are under “More filters”.
POST_SALE.EMPTY_HELP: Check the purchase date, seller and status filters. Use Clear filters to broaden the search.

SUMMARY_HELP.ALL: Pending: awaiting a schedule or scheduled. In progress: queued or sent without delivery confirmation. Delivered: delivery or reading confirmed. Issues: failed, missed or unconfirmed within the time limit.
SUMMARY_HELP.SCHEDULED: Awaiting schedule: no date assigned yet. Scheduled: waiting for the planned send date.
SUMMARY_HELP.PROCESSING: Queued: Chatwoot queued the message. Sent: the provider accepted it, but delivery is not confirmed yet.
SUMMARY_HELP.DELIVERED: Delivered: delivery was confirmed. Read: reading was also confirmed. Neither means the customer replied.
SUMMARY_HELP.FAILED: Failed: a send error occurred. Not executed: no attempt within the time limit. Unconfirmed: attempted without confirmation; it may have arrived.
SUMMARY_HELP.MANUAL_PENDING: Requires a seller to contact the customer. Save the outcome in “Record manual follow-up”.

STATE_HELP.AWAITING_PLAN: The purchase is registered; this stage still needs a scheduled date.
STATE_HELP.SCHEDULED: Waiting for the scheduled date. No manual contact is needed for now.
STATE_HELP.QUEUED: Chatwoot created and queued the message. Sending and delivery are not confirmed yet.
STATE_HELP.SENT: The provider accepted the request and assigned an identifier. Delivery to the customer is not confirmed yet.
STATE_HELP.DELIVERED: The channel confirmed delivery. This does not imply a customer reply.
STATE_HELP.READ: The channel confirmed the customer read the message.
STATE_HELP.FAILED: The send did not complete. Review the reason and manual task status.
STATE_HELP.UNCONFIRMED: No delivery confirmation arrived within the deadline. Review the manual task.
STATE_HELP.NOT_EXECUTED: This stage was not sent on schedule. Check whether manual contact is required.
STATE_HELP.CANCELLED: The follow-up stopped because the sale was canceled or the contact was excluded. This stage will not be sent.

NEXT_ACTION.PENDING: Manual contact is needed. Contact the customer and record the outcome using the action in this row.
NEXT_ACTION.RESOLVED: Manual contact has already been recorded. The original automatic message status is preserved.

WINDOWS.CLOSING_SOON_HELP: WhatsApp conversations whose 24-hour window closes in the next 6 hours.
WINDOWS.CLOSED_TODAY_HELP: WhatsApp conversations whose 24-hour window closed today. Only an approved template can reach them now.

WINDOWS.TITLE: Follow-ups
WINDOWS.DESCRIPTION: Review WhatsApp messaging windows and open each conversation to continue helping the customer.

POST_SALE.TITLE: Post-sale
POST_SALE.DESCRIPTION: Review purchase follow-ups, check delivery and complete pending manual tasks.

FOLLOW_UPS.TITLE: Commercial follow-up
FOLLOW_UPS.DESCRIPTION: See who is in follow-up, who received each step and what is scheduled for each day. You can send or reschedule a follow-up when needed.

FUNNEL.DESCRIPTION: Inquiries, human attention and sales outcomes. Select a number to see its details.
FUNNEL.COHORT_HELP: Uses the inquiry start date. Each inquiry has one current state. Assignment and attention are milestones; overdue replies are separate incidents. A sale may have no recorded human attention.
FUNNEL.ACTIVITY_HELP: Totals count distinct inquiries. An inquiry may appear under several sellers or dates: do not add rows or dates to calculate the unique period total.
FUNNEL.EMPTY: No inquiries started in this period. Activity may include earlier inquiries.
FUNNEL.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the commercial report. Try again.
FUNNEL.PREVIOUS_RESULTS: The previous results are still displayed. Retry to apply the selected filters.
FUNNEL.LIST_ERROR: Could not load the inquiries. Try again.
FUNNEL.ACTION_ERROR: Could not save the change. Try again.
FUNNEL.EXPORT_ERROR: Could not export the inquiries. Try again.
FUNNEL.NEW_CONFIRMATION: Confirm a new buying intention. Warranty questions, support and thank-you messages do not create a new opportunity. The previous sale is preserved.
FUNNEL.OVERDUE_ALERT: {count} inquiry awaiting a seller reply | {count} inquiries awaiting a seller reply
FUNNEL.SHOW_DAILY: View details by seller and period

FLOW.PERIOD: Inquiries received in the selected period
FLOW.NO_SELLERS: No sellers with inquiries match these filters.

ACTIVITY_METRIC_HELP.RECEIVED: Uses the inquiry start date and its commercial owner in the report.
ACTIVITY_METRIC_HELP.ASSIGNED: Uses the assignment or reassignment date and the seller who received the inquiry.
ACTIVITY_METRIC_HELP.ATTENDED: Uses the human reply date and the seller who replied. Automated messages do not count.
ACTIVITY_METRIC_HELP.WON: Uses the date the sale was recorded and the seller preserved in its outcome, even when another person records the sale.

STATUS_HELP.ALL: Every chat with the seguimiento label or with a recorded sequence.
STATUS_HELP.SCHEDULED: Enrolled with pending messages. Each step goes out at 10:00 on its scheduled day.
STATUS_HELP.AWAITING_FINISH: They received all three messages. The sequence closes by itself two days after the last one.
STATUS_HELP.FINISHED: The sequence is over: they received all three messages and the label was removed.
STATUS_HELP.PAUSED: Someone removed the seguimiento label. They receive nothing until it is added again.
STATUS_HELP.UNENROLLED: They have the label but were never enrolled, so they receive no messages. Enroll them so the first one goes out tomorrow at 10:00.

BLOCKED.NO_SELLER: Will not go out: the conversation is not assigned to a follow-up seller.
BLOCKED.CHANNEL: Will not go out: the channel is not WhatsApp Cloud.
BLOCKED.CONTACT_BLOCKED: Will not go out: the contact is blocked.
BLOCKED.EXCLUDED_LABEL: Will not go out: it has an exclusion label (no-contactar, venta-cancelada or venta-perdida).
BLOCKED.TERMINAL: Will not go out: the inquiry already ended as a sale or a loss.
BLOCKED.NOT_ENROLLED: Will not go out: it is not enrolled in follow-up yet.

AGENDA.TITLE: Send schedule
AGENDA.HELP: Number of follow-ups scheduled for each day. Messages go out at 10:00 Argentina time.

FOLLOW_UPS.SELECT_ALL: Select all that can be enrolled
FOLLOW_UPS.CONFIRM_SEND: Step {step} of the follow-up will be sent to {name} now. Confirm?
FOLLOW_UPS.CONFIRM_ENROLL: {name} will be enrolled. The first message goes out tomorrow at 10:00 (Argentina time). Confirm?
FOLLOW_UPS.CONFIRM_ENROLL_SELECTED: {count} chats will be enrolled. Each one gets the first message tomorrow at 10:00 (Argentina time). Confirm?
FOLLOW_UPS.NEW_DATE: New date for the next send
FOLLOW_UPS.RESCHEDULE_HELP: Pick a date after today ({timezone}). The message goes out that day at 10:00.
FOLLOW_UPS.EMPTY: There are no chats in follow-up yet
